title: fss.scene_feature_match_adopted.v2
description: Complete adopted-camera retained scene report with explicit native radial preparation. The v2 rig opts into the exact current FSSCAL two-term Brown model; full source/target grid, source mode, semantic calibration lens basis, actual sampling map, original and corrected exposure/pixel/mask identities and coverage remain visible. Each selected camera may use native correction, or direct original pinhole pixels only when its exact radial terms are zero. Rectified target K and grid are fixed to the refined original camera; model and source bindings are verified by the native command, not inferred by Schema. Pixel-noise covariance excludes lens-parameter error and interpolation correlation; local calibration covariance remains conditional and absolute error unknown. Complete static or temporal diagnostics, current adoption/source/privacy revalidation and all nonrenewable cost axes are preserved. No calibration, world, identity or access authority is activated. Exact report-body UTF-8 hashing and 32-MiB output bound remain unchanged.

image_processing.description: Actual direct original-pinhole output or complete native Brown two-term rectification receipt. In corrected mode k3, p1 and p2 are zero; lens basis, refined source=target K/grid and original source domain must equal the selected current calibration. Every positive-weight source privacy tap and full output descriptor support is required. Cross-record numeric/digest equality is enforced by the command.
